name: email
label: Email address
help_text: The email this pill links to. Update when someone's email changes.

name: display_email
label: Display email (shown on pill)
help_text: Usually the same as the email address. Shown as the main text on the pill.

name: person_name
label: Person's name
help_text: Shown in smaller text below the email. Used to identify who this is.
